newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close slightly up ending a bear-run.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close slightly up ending a bear-run.

text.p: A lingering bearishness came to an end as the Dhaka stocks closed slightly up with investors buying select scrips, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index rose 4.29 point or 0.23 percent at 1,843.66 on a turnover of 39.9 million taka on Tuesday. Of 79 traded issues 38 rose and 41 lost.

Brokers said the market was stabilising after nine days of slide. "There are shares which have reached to their lowest and it's time now for them to attract investment and recover slowly," said one broker. IDLC lost 355 taka to 4,000, Wonderland Toys gained 36 to 487 and Beximco Infusion rose 20 to 515.
